t: Pipulate's Blueprint for AI Collaboration: Architecting Workflows & Context
s: Pipulate is a system for streamlining AI-driven workflows, offering notebook-like sequential processing via FastHTML/HTMX apps. It focuses on translating technical capabilities into client-facing deliverables, particularly in advanced SEO and AI Education, with a Master Prompt for AI orientation.
